parts.answer: Median Mathematics $40$; median English $55$, so English has the higher median. Mathematics range $100$ and English range $60$, or Mathematics IQR $68$ and English IQR $20$, so Mathematics marks have greater spread.
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Median Mathematics $=40$ [M1 indication of finding medians, e.g. graph mark/reference to 700 pupils; condone “mean”]. Median English $=55$ [A1 both correct; condone $54<English<56$, but 54 or 56 A0]. English median larger than Mathematics median [B1; median must be referenced, no credit for “means”]. Mathematics range $=100$ or IQR $=80-12=68$ [M1 evidence of finding both ranges or both IQRs, i.e. subtraction]. English range $=60$ or IQR $=62-42=20$ [A1 both ranges/IQR correct]. Mathematics marks have more spread than English marks [B1; accept standard deviation but figures must be seen]. Total 6.
